name: Blueprint Custom Apparel
old_description: Exceptional printing quality with personalized service from real experts. Bulk orders for trade shows, businesses, and events.
about:
Blueprint Custom Apparel was founded in 2019 in Derry, New Hampshire. The company operates as a provider of custom-branded apparel and promotional products, serving clients across New England and beyond. Its founders set out to deliver high-quality decorated apparel with a focus on personal service.

The shop specializes in screen printing and embroidery, producing custom sweatshirts, jackets, T-shirts, hats, and a range of branded accessories. It also sources promotional items for corporate giveaways and events. All decoration work is performed in-house at its New Hampshire facility, and each piece is described as a symbol of local excellence crafted in New England.

Its customer base includes small businesses, K‑12 schools, universities, U.S. government agencies, enterprises, and startups. The company regularly fulfills bulk orders for trade shows, corporate events, and uniform programs.

Blueprint emphasizes a hands‑on approach: each account is assigned a dedicated sales representative, and the company guarantees premium materials and consistent craftsmanship on every order. Its stated mission is to elevate brand identities through reliable, high‑quality decorated apparel.
